full_judgment:
21. SA record, mutation rent receipts, tax receipts in respect of suit land of the plaintiffs though not the evidence of title, these are clearly the evidence of possession, yet title follows possession. Onus is upon the defendants to rebut such presumption, but the defendants have totally failed to rebut such presumption. We receive support of the above view in case reported in 35 DLR (AD) 216 and 38 DLR 327.
